written.headline: Google lets schools disable Gemini but forces AI in Search
written.summary: Google announced that K‑12 administrators can turn off Gemini, Gemini Notebook and AI features individually. However, schools that block AI will also lose access to Google Search, which now always includes AI Mode and AI Overviews.

written.headline: CrowdStrike to acquire Fiddler AI and Dreadnode for $495 million
written.summary: CrowdStrike announced agreements to buy AI agent observability firm Fiddler AI for about $400 million and AI security testing startup Dreadnode for about $95 million. The deals are slated to close by Jan. 31 2027 and will extend the Falcon platform with pre‑deployment testing and runtime monitoring tools.
